answer.reason: The verses tell of Belshazzar's feast with the temple vessels and of his death the night the writing was interpreted.

clauses.english: made a great feast and drank from the golden vessels taken from the temple at Jerusalem
clauses.quote: commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple

clauses.english: was slain in the night, after Daniel read the writing on the wall
clauses.quote: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.

doubts: DAN 5:2 is quoted from the verse that names him; the quote is 15 words or fewer only if trimmed, so it may need shortening.
DAN 7:1 and DAN 8:1 only date visions by his reign and add nothing for a clause.
The second clause mentions Daniel reading the writing, which DAN 5:24-28 supports but the marked verses do not state directly.
